featured_reviews.review_text:
A must come restaurant if your own your visit to the madh Islands. The food is amazing.. the Aroma of the food gets you drooled 🤤. The staff is very friendly. They recommend the tastiest delicacies of the chef.
Our all time favourite is the Prawns Tandoori and the Chicken Malai Tandoori. Chicken lollipops are just fantastic.

My personal suggestion is to visit this place during dinner  time as the place is completely lit up with wonderful lights and its not so hot. The seating is mostly inside a beautiful shack and makes it a little cozy having your own personal space. No Drinks and smoking allowed inside the premises.
As the name says Bollywood stars so is the music. Pure bollwood.

Lastly i wud say that it's the wonderful food and the beautiful ambience that keeps getting me all the time to this place whenever I visit the madhislnds.

But, one can imagine the ambience in night. The food was great and service was quick too. Really recommended for dinner if one is visiting Madh Island.

featured_reviews.name: Prathama Mohanty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had been here for dinner during our stay in madh Island.
Hut themed restaurant, each hut has some Bollywood stars photos.
You can choose to sit in hut or open space. Recommended to visit at night as it's a open space.
Coming to food, they have varities of options in their menu. We had ordered chicken lollipop, Tawa prawns fry, cheesy chicken kabab, chicken fingers, dimsum, lemon ice tea.
Delicious food, reasonable price, quantity and quality was upto mark.
Service was lil slow. Apart from that we had a nice experience.
A must try out place if you are in madh Island.

featured_reviews.name: Nimish Naik
featured_reviews.review_text:
A quick google search for nearby restaurants during our stay at madh Island led us to this amazing Hut themed restaurant called "Bollywood Stars".

We were given a warm welcome by Mr Gulzar who attended us and recommended some of the most popular dishes the restaurant has to offer.

We tried Surmai tawa fry, Tandoor prawns, Malai tandoori kebabs, Burnt chilli chicken pot rice, gulab jamun. We absolutely loved the tandoor prawns, malai tandoori kebabs and the pot rice.

Great service by Mr Gulzar. Highly recommended. Can't wait to visit again!

featured_reviews.name: Maanta Dewan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great place located in Madh Island. We called for delivery from here and the food was well packaged.
This is what we ordered:
Bharwan mushrooms
Hara bhara kebab
Paneer tikka masala
Dal tadka
Jeera rice
Chicken angara masala
Chicken tikka roll
Roomali roti: 2
Tawa paratha: 1
Tandoori roti: 2
Fresh lime soda: 2
Honey noodles + icecream: 2

Everything was quite tasty and filling. The rotis were soft even after reheating and I absolutely loved the mushrooms, paneer tikka masala and kebabs. They have a long menu and a lot of options in North Indian and Chinese in both veg and non veg. My family loved it and I'm sure so will yours ☺️
Looking forward to visiting this place soon and trying the Chinese dishes here as well.

P.S. I also post updates on Instagram (maanta_d)
Happy hogging 🍴

featured_reviews.name: Indiana Jonas
featured_reviews.review_text:
We joined this tour expecting a true immersion into the world of Bollywood.
The studio is indeed a real working studio used for filming, but the experience offered does not quite match what one might imagine from a “Bollywood tour.”

You get to see sets and filming areas, but it is not access to major film productions or the behind-the-scenes world of iconic Bollywood movies. The visit feels more like a tourist-oriented presentation than an authentic insight into the Indian film industry.

It is not a bad visit in itself, but it may create expectations that are not fully aligned with reality. In my view, it is not truly a Bollywood experience in the way it is advertised.

featured_reviews.name: Dr Anuradha Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Film Studios: The Heart of Cinematic Magic

Film studios are the creative powerhouses that bring stories to life, turning scripts into immersive visual experiences. These spaces are more than just physical locations—they are hubs of imagination, where directors, actors, and technicians collaborate to craft films that captivate audiences worldwide. From grand soundstages to cutting-edge post-production facilities, film studios play a vital role in shaping the magic of cinema. Whether producing large-scale blockbusters or intimate indie films, these studios provide the foundation for storytelling at its finest, blending artistry with technical brilliance.

Yash Raj Films: A Legacy of Excellence in Indian Cinema

Yash Raj Films (YRF) stands as a pillar of Indian cinema, synonymous with grandeur, romance, and timeless storytelling. Founded by the visionary Yash Chopra, YRF has redefined Bollywood with its unparalleled craftsmanship, producing films that resonate across generations. From heartwarming love stories to gripping thrillers, the studio has consistently set new benchmarks in filmmaking. Beyond its artistic brilliance, YRF has also built an empire with its state-of-the-art studios, fostering talent and innovation. With its keen eye for storytelling and commitment to excellence, Yash Raj Films continues to shape the future of Indian cinema, leaving an indelible mark on audiences worldwide.

featured_reviews.name: Kevin Loilargosain
featured_reviews.review_text:
A fantastic and interactive Bollywood experience!

What a great experience! This tour is an absolute must if you're looking for an incredibly fun and interactive outing.

We started our day by dressing up in various iconic Bollywood outfits. We took pictures in these, which were then edited so professionally that it felt like we were in a real movie! After that, we hit the studio to sing our hearts out to famous Bollywood songs. As a great finale to this part, we even got to dance along with real Bollywood dancers.

Next, we were given a fascinating tour through the different studios. It was incredibly fun and special to get a peek at an active film set! After that, we were guided through the other studios and received engaging explanations about the whole process. This really brought the magic of filmmaking to life for us.

Finally, I want to give a huge compliment to the staff: everyone was incredibly friendly, enthusiastic, and helpful. They truly made this experience complete!
